newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan Treasury holds open T-bond auction.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan Treasury holds open T-bond auction.

text.p: The Moroccan Treasury closes on Thursday a public auction of T-bonds on the Casablanca stock market, to which private institutions and foreign investors are being allowed to participate for the first time, a bourse official said.
It is the third Treasury auction on the bourse this year, the official said.
Individuals and institutions are allowed to subscribe to unlimited amounts, he added.

The bourse said the subscriptions would be accepted in dirhams as well as in foreign currency. The interest would be payable annually, it added.
Last month the finance ministry cut by half a point to 9.0 percent the annual interest rate on public Treasury bond issues.
The public treasury bonds are listed on the Casablanca stock exchange as part of the state domestic debt, oriented to small investors.
